title: AI Deployment Authorisation: A Global Standard for Machine-Readable Governance of High-Risk Artificial Intelligence
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not present a benchmark and does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. It proposes a governance framework (ADAS) for authorizing the deployment of high-risk AI systems.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it is not a subject of its analysis. The focus is on a machine-readable governance framework for high-risk AI in safety-critical domains.
